Name: Treasure Chest at Casino
Author: Schneitizel
Description:
Add the item "Treasure Chest" at the Casino ; Now you can exchange your QI coins for gold (or almost)

The "Treasure Chest" can be exchanged for 1000 QI coins, so about 10 000g; the Treasure Chest can then be sold for 5 000g
The goal of the mod is to offer a solution to exchange your winnings for gold, without giving you back your entire stake, play more to win more!

Fully compatible with all mods, even those who add items to the casino!

[size=3][b]Needed :[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url]﻿
[*]And, of course, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Install :[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Just drag&drop the folder "Treasure Chest at Casino" in the archive in your "Mods" folder
[/list]
[size=3][b]Uninstall :[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Just delete the folder "Treasure Chest at Casino"
[/list]
[size=3]Config :[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]You can adjust the purchase price of the Treasure Chest in the shops.json file, line 8: [/size]
[*][size=2] ﻿"StockPrice": 1000,[/size]
[*][size=2]Just change 1000 by the number of QI coins needed for the purchase (I don't recommend less than 500, because you can already buy 500 QI coins for 5 000g, the resale price of the Treasure Chest; putting less will allow you to buy IQ coins, spend them on Treasure Chest, and resell them for more, but that's up to you ;))[/size]

[/list]
